messages.content: Write print-safe folded greeting card copy and exact per-panel image-generation prompts. Return only JSON with exactly four panels: front, inside-left, inside-right, back. Use approved memories only, avoid private claims, keep copy concise for a 5x7 layout, and make each image_prompt a concrete visual composition rather than a restatement of form fields.

{
  "task": "Generate greeting card copy and literal image-generation prompts as JSON only.",
  "required_schema": {
    "panels": [
      {
        "id": "front",
        "headline": "string",
        "body": "string",
        "art_direction": "string",
        "image_prompt": "string",
        "image_negative_prompt": "string"
      },
      {
        "id": "inside-left",
        "headline": "string",
        "body": "string",
        "art_direction": "string",
        "image_prompt": "string",
        "image_negative_prompt": "string"
      },
      {
        "id": "inside-right",
        "headline": "string",
        "body": "string",
        "art_direction": "string",
        "image_prompt": "string",
        "image_negative_prompt": "string"
      },
      {
        "id": "back",
        "headline": "string",
        "body": "string",
        "art_direction": "string",
        "image_prompt": "string",
        "image_negative_prompt": "string"
      }
    ],
    "memory_citations": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "constraints": [
    "Exactly four panels.",
    "Use each panel id exactly once in this order: front, inside-left, inside-right, back.",
    "Use only provided memory_notes.",
    "No order/payment claims.",
    "headline <= 120 characters.",
    "body <= 600 characters.",
    "image_prompt is the exact prompt the image model will receive for that panel.",
    "image_prompt must be a concrete visual composition, not a restatement of form fields.",
    "image_prompt must not include labels such as Recipient, Relationship, Occasion, Tone, Style, Language context, Panel headline, Panel body, or Art direction.",
    "Do not ask the image model to render the headline or body. The app overlays typography after generation.",
    "Use symbolic objects, patterns, backgrounds, stationery illustration, and print design details.",
    "Do not include people, faces, bodies, hands, customer groups, shop owners, signatures, handwriting, or portraits unless the user explicitly asks for a portrait/photo.",
    "For each image_prompt include: premium 5x7 vertical greeting card panel, the panel role, specific visual motifs, palette, style, composition, print-ready quality, no people/no hands, and no logos/no watermark/no readable text.",
    "image_negative_prompt is a concise comma-separated list of visual failure modes to avoid for that panel, and must include readable text, people, face, portrait, hands, folded card mockup, physical card mockup, tabletop scene.",
    "Return JSON only, no markdown."
  ],
  "input": {
    "sender": "Manny",
    "recipient": "Sara",
    "relationship": "friend",
    "occasion": "birthday",
    "tone": "warm, grateful, relaxed, quietly joyful",
    "style": "botanical watercolor, morning light, cream paper, deep green accents",
    "language": "English",
    "personal_note": "She loves morning hikes, coffee, and the fern by her kitchen window.",
    "memory_notes": [
      "She keeps a fern by the kitchen window.",
      "She loves morning hikes and tiny trail flowers.",
      "The birthday card should feel personal without feeling overly sentimental."
    ]
  }
}

message.content:
{
  "memory_citations": [],
  "panels": [
    {
      "art_direction": "warm, grateful, relaxed, quietly joyful",
      "body": "Wishing you a birthday as bright as the morning sun and as lush as the fern by your kitchen window.",
      "headline": "Happy Birthday, Sara!",
      "id": "front",
      "image_negative_prompt": "readable text, people, face, portrait, hands, folded card mockup, physical card mockup, tabletop scene",
      "image_prompt": "a premium 5x7 vertical greeting card panel featuring a serene botanical watercolor scene of a fern in a delicate morning light with deep green accents on cream paper"
    },
    {
      "art_direction": "warm, grateful, relaxed, quietly joyful",
      "body": "May your special day be filled with the simple joys of life: a warm cup of coffee, a gentle breeze, and the beauty of nature.",
      "headline": "Wishing You a Joyful Birthday!",
      "id": "inside-left",
      "image_negative_prompt": "readable text, people, face, portrait, hands, folded card mockup, physical card mockup, tabletop scene",
      "image_prompt": "a premium 5x7 vertical greeting card panel featuring a watercolor illustration of a trail with tiny wildflowers and a few morning clouds on a light blue background with a subtle texture resembling rough paper"
    },
    {
      "art_direction": "warm, grateful, relaxed, quietly joyful",
      "body": "Here's to another year of exploring the great outdoors, sipping coffee, and appreciating the little things in life.",
      "headline": "Cheers to Another Year!",
      "id": "inside-right",
      "image_negative_prompt": "readable text, people, face, portrait, hands, folded card mockup, physical card mockup, tabletop scene",
      "image_prompt": "a premium 5x7 vertical greeting card panel featuring a watercolor scene of a serene forest with a winding path, dappled light, and a few ferns on a soft green background with a subtle texture resembling rough paper"
    },
    {
      "art_direction": "warm, grateful, relaxed, quietly joyful",
      "body": "Thank you for being an amazing friend and for sharing your love of nature with me.",
      "headline": "Thank You for Being You!",
      "id": "back",
      "image_negative_prompt": "readable text, people, face, portrait, hands, folded card mockup, physical card mockup, tabletop scene",
      "image_prompt": "a premium 5x7 vertical greeting card panel featuring a watercolor illustration of a fern with a few coffee cups and a book on a small table on a soft green background with a subtle texture resembling rough paper"
    }
  ]
}
